name: Duskling
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Enhanced Jump.

Add 2 feet to the distance you can leap with a running High Jump|XPHB and 10 feet to the distance you can leap with a running Long Jump|XPHB.

Inner Magic.

You have magic inside you that you can manipulate to enhance your physical or mental attributes. When you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, choose one of the following benefits, which lasts until you choose a different ability.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can switch to a different benefit. You can switch the benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

  • Ardor.

    You have Advantage|XPHB on Charisma ability checks and on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

  • Mobility.

    Your Speed|XPHB increases by 10 feet, and climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement.

  • Vigor.

    You gain a number of Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you have Advantage|XPHB on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
